name: Slit-scan code buffer
doc: Sweeping temporal slit-scan ribbon over the input media whose trailing feedback history decays into live-mutating terminal code glyphs, warped by subject edges with beat-synced slit surges and onset macroblock RGB tears.

palette.doc: phosphor palette for glyph trails and slit cursor highlight

axis.doc: direction of the rolling slit-scan code ribbon

drift.doc: scroll speed of the slit-scan history

slit.doc: width of the live media capture slit

cell.doc: code glyph cell height in pixels at 1080p

glyph_mix.doc: how strongly trailing slit-scan history quantizes into code glyphs

rgb.doc: RGB chromatic split on beats and onsets

tear.doc: onset macroblock and scanline tear strength

decay.doc: persistence of the slit-scan code trail
